# Bhairav Painting Service

> Professional painting contractor in Bhiwandi, Maharashtra with 47+ years of experience and 500+ completed projects, serving Mumbai, Thane, Kalyan, Navi Mumbai and surrounding areas.

Bhairav Painting Service offers residential, commercial, exterior, building, texture, designer wall and waterproofing painting services with owner-supervised work, branded paints only (Asian Paints, Berger, Nerolac, Dulux), free site visits and written quotations.

## Services

- [Residential Painting](https://bhairavpaintingservice.vercel.app/services/residential): Flats, apartments, villas, row houses and housing societies
- [Interior Painting](https://bhairavpaintingservice.vercel.app/services/interior): Bedrooms, living rooms, kitchens, hallways and complete home interiors
- [Exterior Painting](https://bhairavpaintingservice.vercel.app/services/exterior): Homes, villas, buildings and weather-resistant exterior coatings
- [Building Painting](https://bhairavpaintingservice.vercel.app/services/building): Housing societies, high-rise buildings and apartment complexes
- [Commercial Painting](https://bhairavpaintingservice.vercel.app/services/commercial): Offices, shops, showrooms, warehouses and commercial properties
- [Designer & Texture Painting](https://bhairavpaintingservice.vercel.app/services/designer/texture): Royal Play, designer textures, accent walls, stencil work and luxury finishes
- [Waterproofing](https://bhairavpaintingservice.vercel.app/services/waterproofing): Terraces, bathrooms, roofs, basements and exterior walls

## FAQ

Q: Do you offer a free site visit?
A: Yes — free, zero obligation, across all service areas. Call or WhatsApp +91 9158800517 to book.

Q: What is the cost of painting?
A: Cost depends on wall condition, paint brand and area size, so it varies project to project. A free site visit and written quotation is provided with no hidden charges.

Q: Do you supply material or only labour?
A: Both options available — Material + Labour, or Labour Only.

Q: Which paint brands do you use?
A: Asian Paints, Berger, Nerolac, Dulux, Shalimar. No unbranded paints.

Q: Is work owner supervised?
A: Yes, every project is personally supervised by the owner.

Q: Do you handle leakage and seepage problems?
A: Yes, permanent chemical-based waterproofing solutions for terraces, bathrooms, exterior walls and leakage-prone areas.

Q: Do you provide warranty?
A: Yes, workmanship warranty included on all projects.

Q: Do you handle society/building contracts?
A: Yes, including housing societies, commercial complexes and high-rise buildings, with scaffolding available.
